subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is this PR's temporary-script proof enough, or should maintainers require full-runner/gateway proof before choosing it as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877?
rationale: The code shape appears sound, but automation cannot verify the contributor's actual provider/channel setup, and there are multiple open candidate PRs with overlapping fixes.

options.title: Require full-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted gateway logs, terminal output, or a real runner artifact showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: A maintainer may decide the temporary-script transcript and fault-injected tests are enough for this narrow retry predicate change.

options.title: Choose another canonical PR
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 has stronger proof or a preferred implementation, pause this PR and route review to that candidate.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted gateway logs, terminal output, or a real runner artifact showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the clearest current-main owner signal from blame and release-adjacent history on the touched runner files.
